say:3:1711167002:1.text: Aya's blessing, Maxim, you finally pulled through.
say:3:1711167002:1.source_cn: 艾雅眷顾，马克西姆，你终于挺过来了。

say:4:1711167003:1.text: This isn't just the mercy of the Holy Light, is it? Merlin, and you too... Mordrine.
say:4:1711167003:1.source_cn: 这不仅仅是圣光的仁慈吧？梅林，还有你……莫德琳。

choice_prompt:8:1711167006.text: Merlin, could you please double-check on Maxim's health? I only trust your judgment.
choice_prompt:8:1711167006.source_cn: 梅林，能劳烦你再确认一下马克西姆的身体状况吗？我只相信你的判断。

choice_prompt:14:1711167010.text: Although I don't know what efforts you've made, Merlin, please accept my sincerest gratitude.
choice_prompt:14:1711167010.source_cn: 虽然不知道你们付出了怎样的努力，但是，梅林，请接受我最诚挚的感谢。

say:15:1711167011:1.text: You have saved the Empire time and time again, and you have saved me. You are the closest friend of the Radiant Royal Family.
say:15:1711167011:1.source_cn: 你一次次拯救了帝国，拯救了我，你是耀光王室最亲密的朋友。

say:17:1711167015:1.text: You've worked hard these past few years.

say:18:1711167016:1.text: But before that, I'd like to see Orion and Peggy—
say:18:1711167016:1.source_cn: 不过，在那之前，我想见见奥利安和佩吉——

say:20:1711167012:1.text: Mordrine... I can sense that you've done something extremely dangerous behind my back.
say:20:1711167012:1.source_cn: 莫德琳……我能感觉到，你瞒着我做了一件极其危险的事。

say:21:1711167013:1.text: ...I will tell you and Peggy everything exactly as it is, I promise.
say:21:1711167013:1.source_cn: ……我会把一切都原原本本地告诉你和佩吉的，我保证。

choice:14:1:2.text: You should thank Moderin the most.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 你最该感谢的是莫德琳
